name: BENNETT RES (LOGAN & JULIE)
address: 1120 NW HILLSIDE PARK DR, BEND, OR 97703

fr.elements: Main Residence; Front Driveway; Vehicle Parking Area; Walkway; Open Lawn Area; Dense Vegetation; Dense Vegetation; Perimeter Fencing
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Dense Vegetation; Vegetation Near Structure; Limited Rear Access
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly from the road.

• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow fire apparatus and emergency vehicles to reach the structure.

• Trim vegetation along the driveway to maintain clear sightlines and unobstructed vehicle passage to the front of the structure.

• Cut back dense vegetation growing close to the structure to reduce the distance responders must work through heavy growth to reach the building.

• Mark any gate or opening in the perimeter fencing that provides the best available access to the rear of the structure.

• Keep perimeter fence gates unlocked or secured with a Knox-compatible lock to allow responders to reach all sides of the structure without delay.

wildfire.conditions: Large Trees; Tree Cluster; Scattered Trees; Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Vegetation Near Structure; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Scattered Shrubs; Ground Vegetation; Single Access Route; Limited Rear Access; Woody Debris; Open Terrain
wildfire.recommendations:
• Remove woody debris visible near the structure, including fallen branches, wood piles, or dead material on the ground.

• Thin trees in the cluster nearest the structure to create more open space between the canopy and the building.

• Trim lower branches on large trees close to the structure to reduce the path fire can travel from the ground into the tree canopy.

• Clear ground vegetation directly against the structure's walls and foundation.

• Thin scattered shrubs near the structure to break up continuous plant material close to the building.

• Keep the single access route clear of overhanging branches and ground vegetation along both edges so emergency vehicles can pass without obstruction.

• Clear vegetation and debris from the rear of the structure to allow movement around the building and improve visibility for responders.
